Detailed Descriptive.Ordinance: IDOT Local Roads & Streets Manual Ch. 5(-5-7)
Detailed Descriptive.Data notes: All rows will have an IDOT District of 1 (located in northeastern Illinois and including Cook County). We have chosen to retain this field to assist users who may be joining this dataset with similar data produced by organizations in other regions

columns.name: Contract Number
columns.description: unique contract identifier issued by the Office of the Chief Procurement Officer

columns.name: Description
columns.description: professional services sought by Cook County, as specified by the contract

columns.name: Advertised Date
columns.description: date Cook County makes public announcement or legal notice of a solicitation of services

columns.name: Awarded Date
columns.description: date that Cook County Board of Commissioners accepts the contract

columns.name: Selected Firm
columns.description: primary consultant or vendor with whom the contract for service has been executed

columns.name: Proposed Subconsultants
columns.description: consultants proposed to support the selected firm in carrying out the services specified by the contract; subconsultants are separated by semicolon

columns.name: First Alternate
columns.description: vendor first in line to negotiate for services should an agreement not be reached with the selected firm

columns.name: Second Alternate
columns.description: vendor second in line to negotiate for services should an agreement not be reached with the selected firm

columns.name: IDOT District
columns.description: Illinois Department of Transportation region in which the contracted services will take place
